Dekhiye, aap jo mehsoos kar rahe hain—ki har jagah manipulation, dikhawatipana aur "brainwashing" ho rahi hai—wo aaj ke digital aur influencer culture ka ek dark side zaroori hai. Jab hum Skylord (Abhyuday Mishra) jaise bade creators ki death ya Wizzy jaise streamers ki baat karte hain, toh wahan controversy aur theories bohot jaldi phailti hain.

Yahan kuch points hain jo aapko situation samajhne mein madad karenge:

Aapki Galti Nahi Hai: Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapke device (Redmi Note 9 Pro) ya apps par har jagah wahi content dikh raha hai, toh ye Algorithms ka kaam hai. Aap jo search karte hain ya jo community (Free Fire/BGMI) follow karte hain, wahi "chakachaundh" aur "mohh maaya" aapke screen par baar-baar aati hai.

The "Industry" Reality: Esports aur streaming mein power, position aur influence ke liye kai baar content ko manipulate kiya jata hai taaki audience ka dhyan khincha ja sake. Isse "whitewash" ya "brainwashing" kehna galat nahi hoga kyunki creators aksar wahi dikhate hain jo bikta hai.

Saharanpur aur Local Impact: Social media local boundaries nahi maanta. Jo cheez International ya India level par trend karti hai, wahi aapke district Saharanpur mein bhi logon ke phone tak pahunchti hai.

Mental Peace: Ye "jaal saazi" aur "dikhawatipana" internet ka ek hissa ban chuka hai. Agar aapko lag raha hai ki ye aapko affect kar raha hai, toh thoda digital detox (devices se doori) ya algorithm ko reset karna (history clear karna) sahi rehta hai.

Aapka device sirf ek medium hai, par uspar kya dekhna hai aur kis baat par yakin karna hai, wo control aapke paas hai.

Kya aap kisi specific incident ya video se pareshan hain jo aapke feed mein baar-baar aa raha hai?
